conceptNote: 淡い紫の映像に薄いチャットを重ね、柔らかく整理する。
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE sophisticated text-free Chrome Web Store discovery tile, landscape 11:7 aspect ratio (target1760x1120), not panoramic. Art direction: refined Swiss digital editorial, restrained proportions, exact alignment, nuanced negative space, crisp flat UI illustration. Communicate instantly: live chat floats OVER video that fills the fullscreen boundary. ONE video surface with four short fine fullscreen L-brackets at its FOUR OUTERMOST corners; right brackets OUTSIDE and beyond chat. Chat is inset on all four sides, about26% video width and60–68%videoheight; video visibly continues BEHIND its translucent panel. Native chat rhythm: five small round avatars with fine horizontal geometric message strokes of varied lengths, airy row spacing, a slender outlined composer and small send arrow at bottom. The strokes are shapes, never text. Only a tiny play triangle at bottom left in the player controls; no central play button. No chat outside fullscreen boundary, no separate sidebar seam. Avoid chunky icons, oversize round corners, bulky card shadows, plastic/clay3D, fake monitor, isometric views, neon glow, ornamental stars, landscape/scenery/people, UI chrome, extra windows. No words, no letters, no numbers, no pseudo-text, no logo or watermark anywhere. The image itself has zero typography. No captions. Keep all essential elements readable at440x280 and220x140.
Direction 10: Matte off-white artboard. A large flat desaturated lavender fullscreen video field with four fine darkplum corner marks enclosing everything. A translucent nearly-white chat inset right, fine darkplum avatar/message shapes and small muted-red send icon. An abstract darkplum diagonal band is clearly visible faintly through the chat. Small muted-red play triangle in left negative space, very fine darkplum playback line. Restrained lavender/plum/ivory editorial palette, not neon, no gradients or material effects.
LATEST REQUIRED LAYOUT: This must resemble the actual YouTube fullscreen livestream viewing composition. Play/pause control appears ONLY as a TINY triangle at the BOTTOM LEFT, in a thin dark player control strip, followed by tiny speaker/volume symbol and a small red LIVE STATUS DOT (dot only, NO word LIVE). Fine progress rule immediately above bottom controls if appropriate. Small fullscreen icon at bottom far-right. Absolutely NO central play button and NO play symbol floating at left-middle. Main center is uninterrupted video imagery. Chat remains overlaid inset right (or left for direction07), above the controls. Four outer fullscreen corners still enclose chat. Text-free. No labels, timestamps, readable words, numbers.
